pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
login=apis.phone.login(username='4436271690', password=pw)
access_token=login['access_token']
alarms=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms.extend(page)
    i+=1

# identify go-to-sleep
chosen=[a for a in alarms if a.get('label','').lower() in ['go to sleep','go-to-sleep']]
if not chosen:
    # fallback to label containing go and sleep
    chosen=[a for a in alarms if 'sleep' in a.get('label','').lower() and 'go' in a.get('label','').lower()]

print('chosen candidates',[(a['alarm_id'],a.get('label'),a.get('time'),a.get('enabled'),a.get('repeat_days')) for a in chosen])
if len(chosen)!=1:
    raise RuntimeError('Expected exactly 1 go-to-sleep alarm, got '+str(len(chosen)))
chosen=chosen[0]

hh,mm=map(int,chosen['time'].split(':'))
new_h=(hh+1)%24
new_time=f"{new_h:02d}:{mm:02d}"
print('updating chosen alarm_id',chosen['alarm_id'],'from',chosen['time'],'to',new_time)

# update chosen time (and keep repeat days)
res_chosen=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=chosen['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, time=new_time, enabled=True, repeat_days=chosen.get('repeat_days'))
print('chosen update result',res_chosen)

# disable all other alarms
rest=[a for a in alarms if a['alarm_id']!=chosen['alarm_id']]
print('disabling rest count',len(rest),'ids',[a['alarm_id'] for a in rest])
rest_results=[]
for a in rest:
    r=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=a['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
    rest_results.append((a['alarm_id'],r))
print('rest update results',rest_results)

# verify
alarms2=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms2.extend(page)
    i+=1

s=[(a['alarm_id'],a.get('label'),a.get('time'),a.get('enabled')) for a in alarms2]
print('verified alarms (id,label,time,enabled):',s)
